body.condition: \[c_0e^{-C_0z^2}\le p_j(z)\le C_0e^{-c_0z^2}\quad\text{for every }p_j\in\{p^C_j,p^\varepsilon_j\},\ z\in\mathbb R,\ j\in I.\]

novel.justification: The two-sided density envelope retains full support while excluding tail sequences that become arbitrarily sparse. It is satisfied by standardized Gaussian causes and noises and by uniformly bounded smooth exponential tilts of them, a concrete domain for continuously measured pairs with approximately Gaussian latent shocks.
